action.description: Defines the action of the message. Value will be rate-response.

jsonReqId.description: The unique identifier for the JSON request. Format is alphanumeric.

senderCompId.description: The Citi-assigned value used to identify the firm sending the message. May  contain special characters ( ‘_’, ‘.’, ‘-‘).

onBehalfOfCompId.description: The Citi-assigned value used to identify the sub-entity. May contain special characters ( ‘_’, ‘.’, ‘-‘)

sendingTime.description: The time of message transmission. Always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as 'GMT'), format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.mmm.

errorCode.description: The error code associated with the response. See the Error Codes tab for a complete list.

errorMessage.description: The error message associated with the response. See the Error Codes tab for a complete list.

rateSetId.description: The Citi-defined rate set ID that the rate belongs to.

ccyPair.description: A six character sorted alpha string comprising two ISO ccy codes that the rate applies to.

bidSpotRate.description: The Bid Spot Rate for the currency pair.

offerSpotRate.description: The Offer Spot Rate for the currency pair.

bidForwardPoints.description: The Bid Forward Points for this tenor (Forward Pricing Only).

offerForwardPoints.description: The Offer Forward Points for this tenor (Forward Pricing Only).

midPrice.description: The Mid Price for the rate.

validUntilTime.description: The time and date that this rate will expire. Note-This is held in GMT / UTC format: yyyyMM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS

isValid.description: A flag that shows that Citi was able to provide the requested rate. If this field is false, then midPrice, points, and rates are zero.

baseCurrency.description: The base currency of the currency pair.

ratePrecision.description: The number of decimal places to which the rate(s) for this tenor should be quoted in regular base/term format.

isTradable.description: A flag to indicate whether the rate is tradable by the client (TRUE) or is to be used for reference purposes only.

fixingRate.description: This field and `fixingsource` field will only be populated once a month on the agreed NDF fixing date. Will contain the fixing rate to be used for this currency pair.

fixingSource.description: Will contain the fixing source associated with the fixingRate field.

valueDate.description: The value date of the rate returned in format: yyyy-MM-dd.

drawDownValidUntilTime.description: Optional field. The extended time and date that this rate will expire for sending draw down orders. This field will be sent only if you are enabled for sending pre-order requests. Note: this is held in GMT / UTC in format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS.

bidOutrightRate.description: The Bid Outright Rate for this currency pair.

offerOutrightRate.description: The Offer Outright Rate for this currency pair.

isMrf.description: Optional field. Applicable when MRF hourly updated rate option enabled. Flag indicates whether this is updated rate due to MRF True indicates updated rate.

rateId.description: Optional field. Applicable when MRF hourly updated rate option enabled. Unique identifier of a rate. Value is incremental. Used for reference purpose to identify latest rate in case of incremental version of rate due to MRF.
